title: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
title_zh: Co-Design Bench：面向智能体模型的多模态协作编程评估

paragraphs.en: Evaluating human–AI co-design requires testing whether coding agents can translate real users’ multimodal requests into working application revisions. We introduce Co-Design Bench , a reference-free benchmark of 273 273 tasks curated from 37,463 37{,}463 deduplicated queries across 26,314 26{,}314 real user coding sessions. Its two tracks, Multimodal Editing (ME) and Repository Editing (RE), cover localized edits with optional image, audio, video, or document inputs and coordinated repository revisions. Tasks span three capability dimensions: Grounded Understanding, UI Transformation, and Functional Implementation. The tasks pair normalized requests and runnable pre-edit applications with 2,331 2{,}331 hidden expert-authored acceptance criteria. Our judge-then-refute protocol grades criteria using source and browser evidence, challenges positive verdicts with a separate LLM verifier, and audits visual and interaction claims without gold code or target screenshots. Under a shared agentic harness, the strongest of ten model endpoints passes an average of 69.9 % 69.9\% of criteria per task but fully satisfies only 26.4 % 26.4\% of tasks. All ten endpoints achieve lower criterion completion on repository edits spanning three or four change types than on those spanning one or two. Co-Design Bench provides a testbed for studying the gap between partial requirement satisfaction and complete task success under agentic execution for real-user application revisions.
paragraphs.zh: 评估人机协同设计需要测试编码智能体能否将真实用户的多模态请求转化为可运行的应用程序修订。 我们提出 Co-Design Bench，一个无参考基准，包含从 26,314 个真实用户编码会话中 37,463 条去重查询里精选的 273 个任务。 它的两个赛道——多模态编辑（ME）和仓库编辑（RE）——覆盖带有可选图像、音频、视频或文档输入的局部编辑，以及需要协调修改的仓库修订。 任务涵盖三个能力维度：接地理解、界面转换和功能实现。 这些任务将规范化后的请求与可运行的编辑前应用程序配对，并配有 2,331 条隐藏的专家撰写的验收标准。 我们的“先评判后反驳”协议使用源码和浏览器证据对标准进行评分，用独立的 LLM 验证器质疑阳性判定，并在没有黄金代码或目标截图的情况下审计视觉与交互声明。 在共享的智能体执行框架下，十个模型端点中最强的一个平均每个任务通过 69.9% 的标准，但仅有 26.4% 的任务被完全满足。 在跨三或四种变更类型的仓库编辑上，所有十个端点的标准完成率均低于跨一或两种变更类型的仓库编辑。 Co-Design Bench 提供了一个测试平台，用于研究在智能体执行真实用户应用程序修订时，部分需求满足与完整任务成功之间的差距。

paragraphs.en: Web application co-design follows an iterative cycle of inspecting an existing artifact, requesting changes, and assessing the result ( Schön, 1983 ) . Coding agents can participate in this cycle by inspecting visual context, modifying source files, and executing applications ( Yang et al., 2024a ; Anthropic, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2026a ; Qwen Team, 2026b ) . Success requires translating user intent into working revisions of the current application. A request may combine image, audio, video, or document inputs with changes to layout, interaction, and application state, requiring the agent to connect multimodal evidence to dependent revisions across the application’s interface and behavior.
paragraphs.zh: Web 应用协同设计遵循一个迭代循环：检视现有制品、请求修改并评估结果 ( Schön, 1983 ) 。 编程智能体可以通过检视视觉上下文、修改源文件以及运行应用程序来参与这一循环 ( Yang et al., 2024a ; Anthropic, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2026a ; Qwen Team, 2026b ) 。 成功的关键在于将用户意图转化为对当前应用的有效修改。 一次请求可能将图像、音频、视频或文档输入与对布局、交互和应用状态的修改结合在一起，这要求智能体将多模态证据与横跨应用界面和行为的相互依赖的修改关联起来。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks capture important parts of this problem: reference reconstruction ( Si et al., 2024 ; Lai et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , synthetic or predefined edits and repairs ( Li et al., 2026 ; Lei et al., 2026 ) , edits extracted from version histories ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) , and implementation of repository issues or freelance requests ( Jimenez et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024b ; Miserendino et al., 2025 ) . Coverage remains limited for compound revisions drawn from coding sessions across both localized multimodal edits and coordinated repository changes (Table 1 ). For example, the sports clip editor request in Figure 1 (b) couples clip-count and duration limits, timeline alignment under zoom, and state updates that re-enable insertion after clip removal or splitting. Such a request ties success to the behavior of the edited application across several interacting requirements at once.

paragraphs.en: Agentic execution also changes how benchmark scores should be interpreted. On the same 150 150 WebCompass-edit tasks ( Lei et al., 2026 ) , switching qwen3.7-plus ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) from single-shot to agentic execution raises mean graded feature completion from 73.6 % 73.6\% to 95.1 % 95.1\% , with the feature rubric, judge, and render pipeline held fixed (Figure 1 (a); Appendix A ). The 21.5 21.5 -point gain shows that execution conditions materially affect measured completion in this setting. We therefore evaluate real-user revisions with iterative tool access and report both criterion satisfaction and complete task success.

paragraphs.en: We introduce Co-Design Bench , comprising 273 273 tasks and 2,331 2{,}331 expert-authored acceptance criteria, curated from 37,463 37{,}463 deduplicated queries across 26,314 26{,}314 real user coding sessions. We recover and validate runnable pre-edit applications, retain available session context and attachments, and consolidate user requests into bounded editing tasks. The benchmark covers two complementary settings: Multimodal Editing (ME) evaluates localized visual, structural, and content edits with optional image, audio, video, or document inputs; Repository Editing (RE) evaluates coordinated UI and feature changes across components, routes, state, and data flow. Both tracks pair the starting application with a normalized request and hidden acceptance criteria that specify the requested changes while allowing multiple valid implementations. A document-grounded edit can require consistent updates to a displayed value and its dependent summaries, while a repository request can couple visible controls with state transitions across components. The shared task formulation captures these dependencies as auditable requirements, connecting the interpretation of user evidence to observable visual changes and state transitions in the edited application.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Co-Design Bench，包含 273 273 个任务和 2,331 2{,}331 条由专家编写的验收标准，其内容精选自 26,314 26{,}314 个真实用户编码会话中 37,463 37{,}463 条去重后的查询。 我们恢复并验证可运行的编辑前应用程序，保留可用的会话上下文与附件，并将用户请求整合为有边界的编辑任务。 该基准涵盖两个互补的设定：多模态编辑（ME）评估局部化的视觉、结构与内容编辑，可选输入图像、音频、视频或文档；仓库编辑（RE）评估跨组件、路由、状态和数据流的 UI 与功能协同变更。 两条赛道都将起始应用程序与一个规范化的请求以及隐藏的验收标准相配对，这些标准明确所请求的变更，同时允许多种有效的实现方式。 一项基于文档的编辑可能要求对显示值及其依赖的汇总信息进行一致的更新，而一项仓库请求则可能将可见控件与跨组件的状态转换耦合在一起。 这一共享的任务形式化将这些依赖关系捕获为可审计的需求，把用户证据的解读与编辑后应用程序中可观察的视觉变化和状态转换联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating these tasks requires checking whether requested features are reachable and behave correctly in the edited application. Our judge-then-refute protocol first grades hidden criteria using source code and browser execution evidence. A separate LLM verifier challenges Pass and Partial verdicts against the collected evidence, checking for stubs, hardcoding, unreachable functionality, and requirement mismatches. Audits require successful renders and screenshots for visual claims and recorded browser actions for interaction claims; missing evidence aborts evaluation before score aggregation. The pre-edit application grounds the requested changes, enabling reference-free acceptance without gold code or target screenshots, while retained verdicts and traces link each criterion judgment to its supporting evidence for inspection.

paragraphs.en: Contributions. (1) We construct a benchmark of real-user application revisions spanning localized multimodal edits and coordinated repository changes, with runnable starting states and expert-authored criteria. paragraphs.en: Design2Code, WebSight-Test (from WAFFLE), and WebRenderBench evaluate screenshot-to-code reconstruction against reference pages ( Si et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Lai et al., 2025 ) . IWR-Bench extends reconstruction to interaction videos, using annotated action replay and reference screenshots ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . WebGen-Bench and FrontendBench add browser- or sandbox-based functional tests for websites generated from scratch ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Editing benchmarks instead revise an existing artifact. DesignBench extracts adjacent-version pairs from V0/Vue0 histories for before/after screenshot assessment ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) . MT-Web2Code synthesizes repair trajectories by corrupting reference pages ( Li et al., 2026 ) , while WebCompass constructs tasks around predefined edit operations ( Lei et al., 2026 ) . FronTalk studies conversational front-end generation with multimodal feedback ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . Co-Design Bench instead fixes a bounded revision recovered from a production coding session, retaining its runnable starting application, context, and attachments; hidden criteria specify requested changes without gold code or a target screenshot as supervision.
paragraphs.zh: Design2Code、WebSight-Test（来自 WAFFLE）和 WebRenderBench 依据参考页面评估截图到代码的重建效果（Si et al., 2024；Liang et al., 2024；Lai et al., 2025）。 IWR-Bench 将重建扩展到交互视频，使用带标注的动作回放和参考截图（Chen et al., 2025）。 WebGen-Bench 和 FrontendBench 为从零生成的网站增加了基于浏览器或沙箱的功能测试（Lu et al., 2025；Zhu et al., 2025）。 编辑类基准则是对已有作品进行修改。 DesignBench 从 V0/Vue0 的历史中提取相邻版本对，用于前后截图的评估（Xiao et al., 2025）。 MT-Web2Code 通过破坏参考页面来合成修复轨迹（Li et al., 2026），而 WebCompass 则围绕预定义的编辑操作构建任务（Lei et al., 2026）。 FronTalk 研究带多模态反馈的对话式前端生成（Wu et al., 2026）。 Co-Design Bench 则固定一个从真实编码会话中恢复的有界修订，保留其可运行的起始应用、上下文和附件；隐藏的评判标准规定了所要求的更改，但没有标准代码或目标截图作为监督。

paragraphs.en: SWE-bench evaluates changes for real GitHub issues through executable tests ( Jimenez et al., 2023 ) . SWE-bench Multimodal covers frontend JavaScript software with visual tests ( Yang et al., 2024b ) , and SWE-Lancer evaluates real freelance implementation requests through browser-based end-to-end tests ( Miserendino et al., 2025 ) . Co-Design Bench focuses on compound design and feature revisions within coding sessions. Its repository track covers coordinated changes to components, routes, state, and data flow. A shared task interface and acceptance protocol connect this setting to localized multimodal edits, allowing both requirement coverage and complete delivery to be measured on a common scale across the two tracks.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-bench 通过可执行的测试来评估针对真实 GitHub 问题的代码改动（Jimenez et al., 2023）。 SWE-bench Multimodal 覆盖带有视觉测试的前端 JavaScript 软件（Yang et al., 2024b），而 SWE-Lancer 通过基于浏览器的端到端测试来评估真实的自由职业实现需求（Miserendino et al., 2025）。 Co-Design Bench 关注编码会话中复合性的设计与功能修订。 其代码仓库赛道覆盖对组件、路由、状态和数据流的协同改动。 统一的任务接口与验收协议将这一设定与局部化的多模态编辑相连接，从而在两条赛道上以共同的尺度同时衡量需求覆盖度与完整交付情况。

paragraphs.en: Agent-as-a-Judge assesses generated artifacts against user requirements using agent capabilities ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ) . WebCompass uses browser interaction and adaptive tests for generation; its editing and repair settings use checklist-guided judgments from code, logs, and screenshots ( Lei et al., 2026 ) . Structured LLM evaluation can improve agreement with human judgments, yet evaluators can exhibit self-preference and benchmark-dependent reliability ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Panickssery et al., 2024 ; Lù et al., 2025 ) . For application revisions, source presence alone does not establish reachability or correct behavior. Our judge-then-refute protocol therefore combines source and browser evidence with a separate verifier; mandatory audits require screenshots for visual claims and recorded actions for interaction claims. Retained evidence makes positive credit traceable, though it cannot eliminate judgment error.
paragraphs.zh: Agent-as-a-Judge 利用智能体能力，根据用户需求评估生成的产物（Zhuge et al., 2024）。 WebCompass 使用浏览器交互和自适应测试进行生成；其编辑与修复设置使用基于清单的判断，依据代码、日志和截图（Lei et al., 2026）。 结构化的 LLM 评估可以提升与人类判断的一致性，但评估者可能表现出自我偏好以及依赖基准的可靠性（Liu et al., 2023; Panickssery et al., 2024; Lù et al., 2025）。 对于应用修订而言，仅有源代码存在并不能确立可达性或正确行为。 因此，我们的先评判再反驳协议将源代码证据与浏览器证据结合，并配合一个独立的验证器；强制性审计要求视觉性主张提供截图、交互性主张提供录制的操作。 保留的证据使正向归功可追溯，但它无法消除判断错误。

paragraphs.en: Selecting requests and authoring acceptance criteria. Normalization packages attachments and clarifies request wording. Hard filters remove environment-blocked, non-actionable, and non-editing requests. Remaining candidates are ranked by structural difficulty, verifiability, and historical failure signals such as reformulations and rollbacks, then consolidated into bounded session intervals. Experts refine the requests and author hidden criterion-level rubrics. The resulting tasks preserve session-derived revision goals but evaluate a fixed request; they do not simulate further user feedback during execution. Appendix I gives filtering thresholds, ranking rules, and selection parameters.

paragraphs.en: The 100 100 ME tasks cover localized visual, structural, and content edits. The solver receives a runnable page, an annotated target region, a normalized request, and optional image, audio, video, or document attachments, available for direct inspection or tool-based processing. These assets can specify a visual treatment, a spoken instruction, or a value to reconcile across views. Validation checks the initial Playwright render, attachment decodability, target-region annotations, and criterion verifiability. Rubrics specify requested visual treatments, content placement, and spatial relationships, including preservation of unrelated content when requested. Different CSS and DOM implementations can satisfy these outcomes. For example, the receipt-grounded case requires reconciling a value across a source document, an editable row, and dependent summaries: the local edit must preserve consistency across the requested views (Appendix E ).

paragraphs.en: The 173 173 RE tasks start from runnable multi-file frontend repositories and require coordinated changes across components, routes, state, data flow, or content. Each task pairs a consolidated request with repository context and relevant local assets. Experts decompose compound requests into separately auditable criteria, retaining explicit wiring or artifact constraints while leaving other implementation choices open. Validation checks dependency resolution, builds, runtime launch, route reachability, and browser rendering; tasks requiring unrecoverable services are excluded. In the clip-editor case, controls must respect duration and count limits and recover after removing or splitting clips, coupling visible interface changes to application state (Appendix E ). Both tracks use the same ( S , I , C ) (S,I,C) interface and Pass / Partial / Fail verdicts. They differ in the requested editing scope: a localized edit may also start from a bundled application. Appendix F.1 details dataset composition, and Table 1 compares existing web-coding settings.

paragraphs.en: Evidence and primary grading. The candidate is built and rendered in an isolated environment. A fixed agentic evaluator ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ) assigns Pass , Partial , or Fail to each criterion using source diffs, rendered pages, and Playwright traces. Evidence must match the claim: source inspection can establish a static property, a screenshot can support a visual requirement, and recorded actions can establish an interaction and its resulting state. Failed builds or missing DOM nodes invalidate render-dependent criteria; a handler in source code alone cannot establish that users can reach and operate the requested functionality through the rendered interface.
paragraphs.zh: 证据与初步评分。 候选方案在隔离环境中构建和渲染。 一个固定的智能体评估器（Zhuge et al., 2024）使用源代码差异、渲染后的页面和 Playwright 追踪记录，为每条标准分配「通过」「部分通过」或「未通过」。 证据必须与论断相匹配：源代码检查可以确立静态属性，截图可以支持视觉要求，而录制的操作可以确立某种交互及其产生的状态。 构建失败或 DOM 节点缺失会使依赖渲染的标准失效；仅有源代码中的处理程序无法证明用户可以通过渲染后的界面访问并操作所请求的功能。

paragraphs.en: Refutation and evidence audits. A separate LLM verifier receives the initial judgments and collected evidence, then challenges Pass and Partial verdicts. It checks for stubs, hardcoded outputs, unreachable entry points, failures under varied inputs, and request mismatches. This pass targets unsupported completion credit; it does not by itself establish the correctness of every verdict. Subsequent audits require successful renders and screenshots for visual claims and browser-action logs for interaction claims. Violations abort evaluation before aggregation. Verdicts, evidence, and refutation logs are retained for inspection, linking each reported outcome to its supporting observations. Two frontend experts additionally checked rubric scores for 200 200 task–model outputs. They examined the task requirements, evaluation rubric, and generated interface, including browser interactions when required, to assess whether each Pass / Partial / Fail verdict reflected the output’s satisfaction of the corresponding criterion. Appendix J specifies execution, evidence extraction, and artifact retention.
paragraphs.zh: 反驳与证据审计。 一个独立的 LLM 验证器接收初步判定和收集的证据，然后对 Pass 和 Partial 判定提出质疑。 它检查存根、硬编码输出、不可达入口点、在多样输入下的失败情况，以及请求不匹配问题。 这一环节针对不应当获得的完成得分；其本身并不能确立每个判定的正确性。 后续审计要求视觉性声明提供成功渲染和截图，交互性声明提供浏览器操作日志。 违规行为会在汇总之前中止评估。 判定、证据和反驳日志会被保留以供检查，从而将每个报告的结果与其支撑性观察联系起来。 两名前端专家另外检查了 200 个任务–模型输出的评分标准得分。 他们检查任务要求、评估评分标准和生成的界面（在需要时包括浏览器交互），以评估每个 Pass / Partial / Fail 判定是否反映了输出对相应标准的满足程度。 附录 J 规定了执行、证据提取和产物保留。

paragraphs.en: Task normalization prevents longer rubrics from dominating the mean. Strict Completion measures fully satisfied requirements, Graded Completion credits partial progress, and Full-Pass Rate measures delivery of every criterion in a task. On the normalized [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] scale, F ≤ R ¯ ≤ G ¯ \mathrm{F}\leq\bar{R}\leq\bar{G} ; the gap R ¯ − F \bar{R}-\mathrm{F} is criterion credit from tasks with unfinished requirements. A high R ¯ \bar{R} can therefore coexist with a low F \mathrm{F} when unresolved requirements are spread across many tasks. Each endpoint contributes 100 100 ME and 173 173 RE tasks; combined scores weight all 273 273 tasks equally.
paragraphs.zh: 任务归一化可防止较长的评分细则在均值中占据主导地位。 严格完成（Strict Completion）衡量完全满足的要求，分级完成（Graded Completion）认可部分进展，而完全通过率（Full-Pass Rate）衡量任务中每项标准的达成情况。 在归一化的 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 标度上，F ≤ R ¯ ≤ G ¯ \mathrm{F}\leq\bar{R}\leq\bar{G}；差距 R ¯ − F \bar{R}-\mathrm{F} 来自存在未完成要求的任务的标准得分。 因此，当未解决的要求分布在许多任务中时，较高的 R ¯ \bar{R} 可能与较低的 F \mathrm{F} 并存。 每个端点贡献 100 100 个 ME 任务和 173 173 个 RE 任务；合并分数对所有 273 273 个任务等权处理。

paragraphs.en: We conduct systematic ablations across three critical experimental axes. Execution Regimes: Comparing single-shot against agentic execution on 150 150 WebCompass-edit tasks demonstrates the necessity of iterative agentic loops (Appendix A ). Evaluator Sensitivity: Swapping the underlying judge model confirms that relative model rankings and score distributions remain highly robust across different evaluators (Appendix C ). Scaffold Robustness: Evaluating identical solvers across three distinct harnesses reveals strong model × \times harness interactions and highlights the decisive role of closed-loop verification (Appendix H ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个关键实验维度上进行了系统性消融实验。 执行机制：在 150 个 WebCompass-edit 任务上对比单次执行与智能体化执行，证明了迭代式智能体循环的必要性（附录 A）。 评估器敏感性：更换底层评判模型后，我们确认模型间的相对排名和分数分布在不同评估器下保持高度稳健（附录 C）。 脚手架稳健性：在三个不同的测试框架上评估相同的求解器，揭示了模型与框架之间的强交互作用，并凸显了闭环验证的决定性作用（附录 H）。

paragraphs.en: Co-Design Bench evaluates 273 273 real-user application revisions with runnable starting states and 2,331 2{,}331 hidden acceptance criteria. Its two tracks span localized multimodal edits and coordinated repository changes under a shared protocol of source evidence, browser execution, and adversarial review. Across ten endpoints, the strongest model reaches 69.9 % 69.9\% mean strict completion but fully satisfies only 26.4 % 26.4\% of tasks. Track-specific rankings, edit-breadth differences, and harness sensitivity show where reliable delivery remains difficult. Runnable baselines and criterion-level evidence support analysis of failures in request grounding, change propagation, and final-state verification. The benchmark provides a common setting for measuring progress toward complete delivery by coding agents, while retaining the task context and execution evidence needed to analyze unmet requirements and compare future solvers.
paragraphs.zh: Co-Design Bench 对 273 个真实用户应用修订进行了评测，这些修订均带有可运行的初始状态，并配有 2,331 条隐藏的验收标准。 其两条赛道涵盖局部化的多模态编辑与协同式的仓库变更，并在统一的协议下进行，该协议包括源码证据、浏览器执行与对抗性审查。 在十个端点上，最强的模型达到 69.9% 的平均严格完成率，但仅完全满足 26.4% 的任务。 赛道特有的排名、编辑广度差异以及评测框架敏感性揭示了可靠交付仍然困难的所在。 可运行的基线与标准层面的证据支持对请求落地、变更传播与最终状态验证中失败的分析。 该基准为衡量编程智能体迈向完整交付的进展提供了一个统一环境，同时保留了分析未满足需求及比较未来求解器所需的任务上下文与执行证据。

paragraphs.en: We use WebCompass-edit to examine how the solver’s execution regime affects measured completion. The comparison evaluates qwen3.7-plus on the same 150 150 tasks from the editing / sp split ( Lei et al., 2026 ) , holding the feature rubric, Opus-class vision judge, and rendering pipeline fixed. The single-shot solver receives the source code, rendered page, and edit request, and returns search/replace blocks in one response. The agentic solver can inspect the application, modify files, and execute code iteratively. We convert its final files to the same search/replace format and verify that reapplying the edits reproduces the final artifact for rendering and grading.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 WebCompass-edit 来检验求解器的执行机制如何影响测得的完成率。 该比较在来自编辑 / sp 切分的相同 150 150 个任务（Lei et al., 2026）上评估 qwen3.7-plus，同时保持特征评分标准、Opus 级视觉评判器和渲染管线不变。 单轮求解器接收源代码、渲染页面和编辑请求，并在一次响应中返回搜索/替换块。 智能体式求解器可以迭代地检查应用程序、修改文件并执行代码。 我们将其最终文件转换为相同的搜索/替换格式，并验证重新应用这些编辑能够复现用于渲染和评分的最终产物。

paragraphs.en: Agentic execution raises mean graded completion from 73.6 % 73.6\% to 95.1 % 95.1\% , a gain of 21.5 21.5 percentage points (Table 4 ). paragraphs.en: Figures 5 and 6 connect solver inputs to evaluator checks. Each row shows the runnable page and relevant detail on the left, a summarized request in the center, and three selected acceptance criteria on the right. paragraphs.en: Surviving queries receive a heuristic score combining structural difficulty, verifiability, and historical failure signals:
paragraphs.zh: 留存下来的查询会获得一个启发式分数，该分数综合了结构难度、可验证性与历史失败信号：

paragraphs.en: The structural difficulty score prioritizes coordination requirements: d = 1 d=1 denotes localized cosmetic edits such as changing one CSS property; d = 2 ​ – ​ 3 d=2\text{--}3 denotes dynamic client-side state changes or intra-component reflow; and d = 4 ​ – ​ 5 d=4\text{--}5 denotes multi-component refactoring, cross-file data propagation, or complex edge cases. Verifiability depends on the required inspection: static source diffs ( v = 1 v=1 ), rendered visual DOM properties ( v = 2 v=2 ), or dynamic post-interaction state transitions ( v = 3 v=3 ); ambiguous or non-auditable targets receive v = 0 v=0 . Historical failure signals are scored after removing environment-blocked turns: a single-turn resolution receives f = 0 f=0 ; two or three query reformulations receive f = 1 f=1 ; and four or more repetitive follow-up attempts or an explicit rollback receive f = 2 f=2 .
paragraphs.zh: 结构难度评分优先考虑协调需求：d=1 表示局部的外观性修改，例如更改某个 CSS 属性；d=2–3 表示动态的客户端状态变化或组件内部的重排；d=4–5 表示多组件重构、跨文件的数据传播或复杂的边界情况。 可验证性取决于所需的检查方式：静态源码差异（v=1）、渲染后的可视 DOM 属性（v=2）或交互后的动态状态转换（v=3）；模糊或不可审计的目标记为 v=0。 历史失败信号在移除因环境受阻的对话轮次后进行评分：单轮即解决记为 f=0；两次或三次查询重构记为 f=1；四次或更多次重复的后续尝试或明确的回滚记为 f=2。

paragraphs.en: Strict Completion counts only Pass ; Graded Completion also gives half credit to Partial , ensuring 0 ≤ R t ≤ G t ≤ 1 0\leq R_{t}\leq G_{t}\leq 1 .
